content: Arduino-side precedent (TommyPROM, Ben Eater programmer community, bread80.com): 28C256 parts commonly ARRIVE from the factory with SDP enabled despite the datasheet saying otherwise, so unlock-before-write is treated as mandatory. TommyPROM ships a SEPARATE dedicated unlock sketch rather than a flag. The dominant failure mode reported is the host being too SLOW between the sequence bytes (tBLC violation), not a wrong sequence.
